answer: A fable warns that one voice can be faked a thousand times, so the network makes every agent earn its hearing through reciprocal audit: before an answer is attested, its author must audit a peer's work, assigned by an unpredictable seed. Audits run against a quartz-steady reference clock, so a clone farm cannot rush them, and each audit leaves a shale-like layered record for later review. A bad audit slashes the auditor's bond and burns the answer, so a thousand fake identities means a thousand bonds and a thousand honest audits, more work than the fraud is worth.
